project.title: Native verification request postcommit mail and destination
project.goal: Prepare bounded verification delivery before issuance commit, send after known commit and return only truthful completion destinations
project.scope: Application and runtime mail/destination composition, no public HTTP or deployed verification authority

boundary.responsibility: Prepare and commit native verification intent then hand off mail; validate destination before completion
boundary.rationale: External delivery and redirect claims must follow the real transaction outcome
excludes: Public HTTP/cookie parsing/generic acknowledgement/timing/rate policy, legacy dualwriters and deployed authority

errors.refused: Fixed errors with NotCommitted/OutcomeUnknown/Committed and checked connection reuse

preconditions: Trusted runtime configuration, canonical admitted control handle and bounded injected sender
Future HTTP must conceal account existence and close authoritative legacy verify-email bypass before enablement
postconditions: Full message prepared before intent commit; no send before known commit and no automatic new-token retry
Optional caller rechecked to current matching email/session under writer without MFA/access/session grants
Unknown commits release no mail/success destination; delivery errors retain committed link with Committed stage
Completion destination validated before mutation; no injected verification bearer and reserved query coordinates removed
external_effects: Canonical issuance or completion transaction inherited from persisted verification
Postcommit synchronous injected mail; concrete HTTPS gateway bounded retries keep payload/token/idempotency key
Trusted Clock and OS entropy; no public route or automatically created session
